facts.fact: CAMTEL's 2026 product sheet says its network includes one Tier III data centre with 20,000 TB of storage, and that it offers colocation and cross-connection to operators and ISPs within its data centre and technical sites.
CAMTEL's 2026 product sheet says its national fibre-optic network of nearly 10,000 km covers the whole territory and carries its inter-city leased lines on the national backbone.
CAMTEL's 2026 product sheet offers operators and ISPs inter-city leased lines (LLI) on its national backbone, IP transit and cross-connection, as wholesale products.

CMR.note: The document states nothing about power outages.

facts.fact: CAMTEL's 2026 product sheet says four submarine cable systems (SAT-3, WACS, SAIL, NCSCS) link Cameroon to Europe, Africa, Asia and the Americas through landing points at Douala, Limbe and Kribi.
CAMTEL's 2026 product sheet sells IPLC and IP transit to operators, ISPs and multinationals, with access to all landing points of SAT-3, WACS, SAIL and NCSCS.
